# Work Order 3 Execution Report: Scopes & Aliases

The implementation of **Work Order 3 — Scopes & Aliases** (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo3`) in [`internal/core/config/scopes.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go) and [`internal/core/config/scopes_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes_test.go) has been verified against all requirements and constraints.

---

## 1. Line-Item Verification

### 1. Declared Scopes Config
- [`ScopeConfig`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L54-L58): Struct with `Topics`, `Externals`, and `Procedures` slices of `DeclaredScope`.
- [`DeclaredScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L17-L24): Defines `Name`, `Kind`, `Keywords`, `ToolNames`, `Commands`, and `Description`.
- [`LoadScopeConfig(configPath)`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L62-L108): Loads `config.yaml` under `scopes:`. Returns an empty config without error if the key or file is missing/empty.

### 2. Derived Module Scopes
- [`ModuleScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L111-L116): Holds `Name`, `Kind`, `PathGlobs`, and `Symbols`.
- [`DeriveModuleScopes(anchors)`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L246-L342):
  - Strips filename and extracts directory.
  - Rolls up directories with $\le 2$ files to the parent directory.
  - Strips `internal/` prefix or preserves `cmd/` prefix, converts `_` to `-`.
  - Parses file anchors and symbol anchors (`file:`, `symbol:`, `#symbol`, `:symbol`).
  - Returns deduplicated, sorted list of module scopes.

### 3. Alias Resolution
- [`AliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L345-L356): Tracks old scope to new dossier mappings.
- [`BuildAliasMap(opsReader, ctx)`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L473-L517): Iterates ops log, collects `OpSplit` operations, and populates mappings for old scope $\to$ new dossiers.
- [`(a *AliasMap) Resolve(scope)`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L420-L444): Resolves alias chains up to depth 10 with cycle detection.

### 4. Scope Resolver
- [`ScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L520-L539): Combines declared scopes, derived modules, and aliases.
- [`(r *ScopeResolver) ResolveScope(anchors, keywords)`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L546-L718):
  1. Checks aliases first.
  2. Matches anchors against module scopes (path prefix / slug / globs / symbols).
  3. Matches keywords against declared topics, externals, and procedures.
  4. Returns the best match or empty string.
- [`(r *ScopeResolver) AllScopes()`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L721-L765): Returns deduplicated, sorted list of all known scopes.
- [`(r *ScopeResolver) ScopeKind(scope)`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L768-L798): Maps resolved scope to `DossierKind`.
